Subject: Zelvane Plumbing Services - Referral Required

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the submission on Zelvane Plumbing Services.

I'll need to refer this one to our senior underwriting team for review due to a few factors:

- Contractor risks require additional approval at our level
- Three locations fall within our coastal exposure zone (within 16km of the coast)
- We're monitoring accumulation in this area as our existing portfolio concentration is elevated

This doesn't mean we can't quote, but it will take a bit longer while we get internal sign-off. I'll circle back within 3-5 business days with next steps.

If timing is tight, you might also consider reaching out to a specialty contractor market—they may have more appetite for coastal contractor risks.

Thanks for thinking of us!

[Underwriter name]
